info.name: Mews Booking Engine API (Distributor) Account notes Companionships API

items.docs:
Returns all companionships based on customers, reservations or reservation groups. One of them must be specified in the request.
Note this operation uses [Pagination](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/guidelines/pagination/) and supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property).
